scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npx -y concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
